text: SELECT m.chembl_id AS chembl_id, m.pref_name AS name, cs.canonical_smiles AS structure, di.efo_term AS indication_efo_term, di.mesh_heading AS indication_mesh_heading FROM molecule_dictionary m INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON m.molregno = di.molregno WHERE m.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND (LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%lymphoma%' OR LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%lymphoma%') ORDER BY m.chembl_id ASC;
